column1: # The slot name: the order, the next number, the number of a role's process (the contract common/contracts/slot-name.md; POOL-ORDER-51-01).
# A row: case<TAB>op<TAB>input<TAB>expect<TAB>note. The form — the package's README.

column5: the example of P/03.2 N1.4: the numeric ones by the number (on equality — by the name: w-01 before w-1), then the others by the name; w-srv-a-1 — the second group
a suffix longer than 64 bits — a number without overflow
«by name» — ASCII bytes; an own prefix before its continuation (w-a < w-a-b < w-ab)
the next — <prefix>-<max+1> by the numeric suffixes; the other names do not take part
no numeric ones — max = 0, the next w-1
leading zeros — the number 7; the new one without leading zeros
a role's process: s — everything between «t-» and «-N», N — the last segment
a server name with «-»: s = rack-1-node-7, N = 3
s ≠ server of the heartbeat — not a role's process (neither of this server nor of any)
no heartbeat, or server does not read — not a role's process
w-5 — no server in the name, not a role's process
N with a leading zero — out of form
another prefix — not a role's process
the last segment is not a number — not a role's process
